name: Gatewatch

bio.text: The four swore the oath after Zendikar and committed to standing against the Eldrazi and other threats.

citations.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

bio.text: Liliana swore the oath after the fight against Emrakul on Innistrad, planning to use the group, and the Gatewatch became a group of five headquartered in Jace's house.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

bio.text: On Kaladesh the Gatewatch sided with the renegades against Tezzeret and the Consulate, and Ajani joined as a fifth member by speaking the oath.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.
"Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

bio.text: They went to Amonkhet to confront Nicol Bolas, who defeated and scattered them.

citations.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

bio.text: On Dominaria Gideon gave Teferi the oath, and in the War of the Spark the group renewed its Oaths and accepted Kaya.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

bio.text: Later, Jace called the group to leave on Dominaria, and Karn and the Gatewatch summoned a strike team to New Phyrexia.

citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

status.text: The latest event that shows the Gatewatch has Emrakul allowing it to seal her in the moon of Innistrad, and the story does not say whether the group still operates.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is formed on a cliffside overlooking Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: The formation of the Gatewatch occurred on Tazeem

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replace Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green planeswalkers as the Gatewatch story begins.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura and Nissa Revane replaced Ajani and Garruk as the archetypal white and green Planeswalkers, respectively.

citation.text: "Planeswalker", section "Gatewatch era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together and form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Liliana confront Emrakul at Thraben; Jace speaks with her figment Emeria.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was confronted by the Gatewatch and Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin warns Jace about the hedron network and berates the Gatewatch for killing Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: Ugin berated them for killing the ancient creatures instead of trapping them

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The death of Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The four Planeswalkers swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch chooses a direct attack: Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura rallied the Zendikari defenders to lead the titans into the ambush

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the cliffs of Tazeem the four pledge their oaths, founding the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Gideon, Jace, Chandra, and Nissa pledged their oaths to protect not only Zendikar but the entire Multiverse from threats too great to face alone

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers swear an oath and found the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and founded the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Gideon, Chandra and Nissa swear an oath, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines and burns them, ending Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Kozilek on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The four swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was realized.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa join forces against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis, becoming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: They become the Gatewatch , a team with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: swear oaths to save the planes together, forming the Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch destroys Kozilek and Ulamog.
timeline.quote: the Gatewatch defeats Kozilek and Ulamog .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane joins the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane joins the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas and is soundly defeated.
timeline.quote: When the Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas , they are soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and planeswalks to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and planeswalks to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends, they scare Ob Nixilis from Zendikar and swear an oath, creating the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus, they swore an oath to stand together, and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch and Kiora, devising a leyline plan with Nissa and using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora's help.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that the Gatewatch has no plan for the third titan, Sorin, Nahiri or other threats like the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: these were threats that could only be handled by Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul is sealed in Innistrad's moon, and Liliana decides to join the Gatewatch to direct it.
timeline.quote: Emrakul had been sealed in Innistrad's moon by the Gatewatch and Tamiyo

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana makes clear that the Gatewatch fights planeswalker threats, not local unrest, when Dovin Baan asks them to guard the Inventor's Fair.
timeline.quote: Liliana, however, quickly made clear that the Gatewatch intended to combat other planeswalkers and similar extraplanar threats, not local unrest.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: she decided to join the Gatewatch , albeit to direct them for her plans

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Shadows Over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren of the Gatewatch investigates Innistrad's dark mysteries.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren of the Gatewatch investigates its dark mysteries.

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben the Gatewatch is saved by Liliana; Chandra then defends the others during the sealing of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: When it became clear that they could not destroy Emrakul, Chandra joined Gideon in defending the other members of the Gatewatch while they conducted the sealing ritual.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace brings the Gatewatch and Liliana brings hordes of undead as unlikely allies to save Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren brings the Gatewatch , and Liliana Vess brings hordes of undead immune to Emrakul's influence.

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
timeline.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
timeline.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
timeline.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
timeline.quote: our hands are tied.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after the Renegade victory.
timeline.quote: He took his oath to protect the innocent from tyrants and to help all beings find their place

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane and the Gatewatch free prisoners and confront Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, igniting open conflict.
timeline.quote: who freed prisoners and confronted Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, ignited open conflict.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan asks the Gatewatch for aid against the renegade threat but is refused.
timeline.quote: he requested the aid of the Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Tezzeret's coup Baan hesitantly cooperates and is promised leadership of the institution manufacturing the streamlined inventions, in exchange for dealing with the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret demanded that Dovin Baan take care of the Gatewatch since it was due to his invitation that they were here.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after they aid the Renegades' rebellion.
timeline.quote: They were helped by Ajani Goldmane , who afterward joined the team.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan travels to Ravnica the day before the Fair to ask the Gatewatch for help; the Gatewatch declines as the issue is internal to one plane.
timeline.quote: traveled to Ravnica the day before the Fair began to ask for the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra drops her disguise and saves Pia, and the Gatewatch joins the fight against Tezzeret and his guards.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch all joined the fighting

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Quicksmithing duel between Tezzeret and Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is unexpectedly confronted by the scheming Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch unexpectedly is confronted by the scheming Tezzeret .

citation.text: "Kaladesh", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret nearly kills Pia but Chandra attacks and the Gatewatch appears; he retreats into the Skysovereign.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret nearly killed Pia, but was attacked by Chandra Nalaar before he could

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
timeline.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
timeline.quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia warns that a huge aether turret at the Spire's base can destroy anything that flies and proposes a ground team to take it out.
timeline.quote: "I might have a way to take it out," Pia said.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Ajani support the Renegades while searching for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch and Ajani Goldmane support the renegades

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra Nalaar to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Disallow depicts Baral's taunting of Chandra Nalaar in an attempt to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Story Spotlight cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch plans with renegades to take over the Aether Hub to fuel an airship and hinder Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: They started planning a takeover of the hub

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Saheeli rescue Rashmi from Tezzeret, and the Gatewatch learns his plan and takes the Aether Hub.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess and Saheeli Rai came to the rescue of Rashmi, freeing her from Tezzeret's clutches

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The revolt turns to reform; martial law ends, Baral is arrested, and Ajani joins the Gatewatch, who deduce Bolas is behind Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Ajani officially joined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and renegades confront Tezzeret at the Aether Spire; Pia Nalaar is instated as a consul.
timeline.quote: Renegade leader Pia Nalaar was instated in a consul's position

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Hub and begin a revolt; the Consulate diverts the Gatewatch with Baral and Dovin Baan and retakes the hub.
timeline.quote: the Consulate retook control of the Aether Hub

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Tezzeret's coup, Saheeli joins the Renegades and Gatewatch and, with Liliana, breaks into the Aether Spire, finding Rashmi gone and the invention rebuilt.
timeline.quote: Saheeli joined forces with the Renegades and the newly arrived Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Renegade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
timeline.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas and meets fierce resistance in the desert and the city.
timeline.quote: When The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas, they meet with fierce resistance in the desert

citation.text: "Amonkhet", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet the Gatewatch confronts Bolas and is soundly defeated, scattering; Jace is trapped on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: When they confronted the dragon, they were soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays the Gatewatch and flees Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Liliana betrayed her friends and fled to another plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
